SASBDB entry SASDRW2  (https://www.sasbdb.org/data/SASDRW2/)

Publication: A solution structure analysis reveals a bent collagen triple helix in the complement activation recognition molecule mannan-binding lectin-associated serine protease-3
DOI:         https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jbc.2022.102799

The publisher's PDF used to be kept in this folder. It was removed from the repository
(size, and the publisher's redistribution terms): fetch it from the DOI above. The
fitting script test/fitting_tests/SASDRW2/ cites the sections and tables it takes the
buffer and sample conditions from.
